versions.changelog:
Initial release of mfg-exp-distill – Manufacturing Best Practices Skill

- Provides structured knowledge and tools for lean production, quality management, supply chain management, and equipment maintenance in discrete, process, and equipment manufacturing sectors.
- Covers industry classification (ISIC), value chain mapping, key manufacturing modes, and industry boundaries.
- Includes core lean methodologies (5S, Kanban, VSM, Kaizen, A3, continuous improvement), waste identification, and value stream analysis.
- Presents practical frameworks for ISO9001 quality management, quality maturity models, SPC, FMEA, DMAIC, and control point setup.
- Supplies supply chain management guidelines: supplier classification, inventory management, and performance evaluation.
- Details TPM, OEE calculation, and equipment maintenance best practices.
- Auto-updates via selected industry sources and keywords focused on manufacturing trends and methodologies.
